AudioUtilTTS - third-party notices
==================================

AudioUtilTTS itself is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0
(GPL-3.0.txt in this folder). Source: https://github.com/crajjjj/AudioUtilTTS

AudioUtilTTS.dll contains the following third-party software, linked statically.

sherpa-onnx 1.13.8
    The speech runtime.
    Copyright (c) Xiaomi Corporation
    Apache License 2.0 (Apache-2.0.txt in this folder)
    https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx

ONNX Runtime
    Runs the voice model. Built into sherpa-onnx.
    Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation
    MIT License (MIT-onnxruntime.txt in this folder)
    https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

espeak-ng
    Turns text into phonemes. Built into sherpa-onnx.
    GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0.txt in this folder)
    https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng

CommonLibSSE-NG
    Skyrim engine bindings.
    MIT License
    https://github.com/alandtse/CommonLibSSE-NG

toml++
    Reads the config file.
    Copyright (c) Mark Gillard
    MIT License
    https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus

sherpa-onnx and ONNX Runtime bundle further libraries of their own (among them
kaldi-native-fbank, kaldifst, piper-phonemize, protobuf and abseil). Their
notices are in the two projects' repositories, linked above.

Voice models are separate downloads and carry their own license inside the model
folder. The default model, kokoro-en-v0_19, is Kokoro-82M by hexgrad, released
under the Apache License 2.0 (https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M). Its
folder also holds espeak-ng-data, which is part of espeak-ng (GPL v3.0).
